services.title: HAIRCUTS
services.description: Sharp Cuts, Clean Finish. From classic fades to modern styles, our barbers deliver precision cuts that suit your face shape and personality. Every visit leaves you looking sharp, confident, and ready to take on the world.

services.title: BEARD SHAVING
services.description: The Perfect Shave, Every Time. Whether you prefer a clean shave or a well-defined beard, our barbers use the finest tools and techniques  to shape, trim, and sculpt your facial hair to absolute perfection.   A true gentleman's experience.

services.title: HAIR COLOURING
services.description: Bold Colour, Flawless Results. From subtle highlights to full transformations, our expert colourists bring your vision to life.  We  use premium products that protect your hair while delivering rich, long-lasting colour that commands attention.

services.title: ACCESSORIES
services.description: Everything a Gentleman Needs. Complete your grooming routine with our carefully curated range of premium barbershop accessories. From  quality razors and combs to styling products, we stock everything you need to maintain your look at home.

features.title: Experience the Finest Haircuts in Town
features.description: Step into a world where every cut is crafted with precision and care. Our experienced barbers are dedicated to delivering a grooming experience that goes beyond the ordinary. We listen, we advise, and we execute, giving you a look that reflects your personality and style.

faq.question: How do I book an appointment?
faq.answer: You can book an appointment by clicking the 'Book an Appointment' button on our website or by calling us directly.

faq.question: How long does a haircut take?
faq.answer: A standard haircut takes about 30–45 minutes depending on the style. Beard grooming and colouring may take longer.

faq.question: Do you accept walk-ins?
faq.answer: Yes we do! However we recommend booking in advance to avoid waiting times, especially on weekends.

faq.question: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.answer: We accept cash, debit cards, and all major credit cards.

testimonials.name: James Okafor
testimonials.review: FERGS is hands down the best barbershop in Lekki. Every time I walk out I feel like a new man. The attention to detail is unmatched.

testimonials.name: David Eze
testimonials.review: I was nervous coming in for the first time but the barbers made me feel so comfortable. Got a fade and everyone at work was asking where I got it done.

testimonials.name: Chukwudi Nwosu
testimonials.review: The home service is a game changer. They came to my house on time, set up professionally and gave me the best cut I have had in years.

testimonials.name: Tunde Adeyemi
testimonials.review: Been coming to FERGS for 6 months now and I would never go anywhere else. The beard grooming alone is worth every penny.

testimonials.name: Emeka Obi
testimonials.review: Walked in without an appointment and still got taken care of quickly. Clean environment, friendly staff and an incredible haircut. Will be back!
